name: Backlog.md
description: Backlog.md as a task source: lists the tasks of your Backlog.md projects on the Tasks page and starts a workspace for any of them.

settings.title: Project folders
settings.description: One folder per line. Each is either a project with a backlog/ folder, or a parent folder searched three levels deep for such projects. ~ means your home folder.

settings.title: Agent prompt
settings.description: Draft typed into the agent when you start a task. Placeholders: {id}, {title}, {status}, {file}, {project}. Leave empty for the built-in prompt.
